Pin useful answers to the message rail and jump back to them later. Pins stay with the chat, use the Bot's accent, and open their answer even inside a collapsed activity group. Long rails fit the available height, and preview cards stay inside the window.

Message previews stay within their own turn. Pin updates preserve the live conversation and usage counters, and rail selection stays on the intended message as history loads.

Bundles gateway 0.16.35 with protocol 94. Remote gateways and clients must use the matching protocol. Build 30.
